snippet.title: Veyora Game Trailer - Coming 2026
snippet.description:
Veyora is a medieval open-world RPG with survival and farming elements. Choose your spot, build a farm, home or base, explore the world and play solo or with friends. Veyora is made by a Swiss based Game Studio.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4087940/Veyora/

Key Features
- Build Freely: Choose your own building spot and create whatever you want from a small farm to a large base.
- Farming & Crafting: Grow crops, raise animals, and craft tools, weapons, and equipment.
- Explore an Open World: Discover villages, forests, ruins, and hidden places filled with resources and stories.
- Dungeons & Enemies: Battle bandits, monsters, and dark creatures, or explore ancient dungeons for valuable rewards.
- NPC Companions & Co-op Mode: Play solo, with AI companions, or online with up to four friends.
- Choose Your Path: Whether peaceful farmer, curious explorer, or seasoned warrior – in Veyora, you decide who you want to be.
- Character Creation: Design your own character exactly the way you want.
- Resource Management: Food, energy, and weather shape your daily life – balance is vital for survival.
- Talents & Spells: Advance through a deep talent system, learn new abilities, and discover ancient magic to strengthen yourself in battle or everyday life.
